$comment: Measured runs the cost estimate is calibrated against. Change it only with a new measured baseline (evals/baseline/), and keep docs/design-notes.md ('Cost estimate and budget') in step.
source: evals/baseline/pool-2026-10-29.md (shramee/zk-audit#10): one blind run per profile on the pool fixture at e198ed7, model claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-29

usd_per_mtok.note: session total_cost_usd divided by the tokens the subagents reported (quick 11.4, deep 12.0, standard 13.5); it carries the orchestrator's own share

confirmed_per_reference.note: the pool fixture is dense with planted bugs (7 PoC builders for 286 in-scope lines in standard and deep), so it gives the high end; real code usually has fewer

runs.note: 24 hunters and 3 retries after safeguard refusals
one pass ran: loop mode was not exercised in this run, so passes 2 and 3 are extrapolated

unmeasured.note: one-circuit fixture on the eval-corpus branch; CI caps it at 4 USD; no measured run is committed, so it is not used for calibration
